title: Language Settings
description: Learn how to configure language preferences for your account, stores, and interface to support multiple languages.
content:
Language Settings

Configure language preferences for your account, stores, and user interface to support multiple languages and serve customers worldwide.

Account Language

Set your account's default language:

  • Interface language
  • Email language
  • Notification language
  • Report language

Supported Languages

Matjrii supports 22+ languages:

  • English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German
  • Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish
  • Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)
  • Japanese, Dutch, Polish, Hebrew
  • Persian, Estonian, Indonesian, Romanian, Thai
  • And more

Store Languages

Configure languages for each store:

  • Default store language
  • Additional languages
  • Language switcher
  • Auto-translation

Interface Language

Change your dashboard language:

  • Navigate to Settings → Language
  • Select preferred language
  • Interface updates immediately
  • All menus and labels translate

Content Translation

Translate store content:

  • Product descriptions
  • Category names
  • Page content
  • Blog posts
  • Email templates

RTL Support

Right-to-left language support:

  • Arabic
  • Hebrew
  • Persian
  • Automatic layout adjustment

Language Switcher

Add language switcher to stores:

  • Header menu
  • Footer
  • Sidebar
  • Dropdown menu

Auto-Detection

Automatic language detection:

  • Browser language detection
  • Customer preference
  • Geographic detection
  • Manual override

Translation Management

Manage translations:

  • Manual translation
  • AI-powered translation
  • Professional translation
  • Translation import/export

Best Practices

  • Set appropriate default language
  • Support customer languages
  • Use professional translations
  • Keep translations updated
  • Test all languages
  • Consider cultural differences

Related Guides

  • Multi-Language Stores
  • Company Settings
